content.text: {"title":"Ishika's Leaf Discovery","gradeSubjectTag":"Class 5 · Science · Why Leaves Are Green","readMinutes":2,"scenes":[{"label":"hook","text":"Ishika was sitting in her grandmother's garden after school, looking at all the different coloured flowers—red roses, yellow marigolds, purple petunias. She asked her grandmother, 'Why are all these flowers so colourful, but the leaves are always green?'"},{"label":"problem","text":"Her grandmother smiled and said, 'That's a wonderful question. Let me show you something.' She picked a leaf and held it up to the sunlight. 'Do you see how green it is? That green colour has a very important job to do.'"},{"label":"mathMoment","text":"'Inside every leaf,' her grandmother explained, 'there is a special green colour called chlorophyll. This chlorophyll traps sunlight and uses it to make food for the plant, just like a kitchen makes food for our family. The chlorophyll is green because it reflects green light and absorbs all the other colours of light—red, blue and yellow. The plant uses that energy to turn water and air into sugar that helps the leaf and the whole plant grow strong.'"},{"label":"wrapUp","text":"Ishika looked at the leaf with new eyes. 'So the leaf is green because it's working hard to feed the plant!' Her grandmother nodded. 'Exactly. And that's why we see so much green in nature—every leaf is busy doing its job, and that green colour is the sign that it's working.' Ishika ran off to draw pictures of leaves in her notebook, now knowing their beautiful secret."} ],"visual":null,"equations":[],"tryTogether":{"question":"You are helping in the garden and notice that some plants have darker green leaves and some have lighter green leaves. Why do you think the darker green leaves might be better at making food for the plant?","answer":"The darker green leaves have more chlorophyll, so they can trap more sunlight and make more food."},"parentPrompt":"Ask Ishika to look at a real plant leaf at home and describe what she sees—is it light or dark green, and what does that tell her about how hard it's working?"}
